title: § 158-1 Mandatory disclosures for rental increases over 10%
requirement: Landlords seeking to increase rent by more than 10% upon lease renewal year over year must provide specific disclosures to existing tenants, including cost itemizations, algorithmic pricing usage statements, tenant legal rights notices, and Hoboken Division of Housing contact info.
coverage_conditions: all residential landlords seeking to increase rent by more than 10% upon a renewal of a lease with a current tenant

title: § 158-2 Algorithmic rent fixing in rental housing market prohibited
requirement: Landlords are prohibited from using software, algorithms, or data-sharing platforms to collect and analyze nonpublic competitor information to coordinate, recommend, or implement rental prices, lease terms, or occupancy levels among competing lessors.
coverage_conditions: any residential dwelling unit excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities in the City of Hoboken
quoted_span: Landlords who rent any residential dwelling unit (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities) in the City of Hoboken are prohibited from price fixing using algorithmic pricing.
